name: OpenAI
description: Powers the Nova support and Sage billing agents via the Responses API

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Secret API key. Without it the portal falls back to deterministic demo replies.
OPENAI_API_KEY.label: API Key

OPENAI_MODEL.description: Model id used by both support agents
OPENAI_MODEL.label: Model

name: Microsoft Entra ID
description: Company sign-in for the leave days page. Optional: without it the rest of the portal works.

ENTRA_TENANT_ID.description: Directory (tenant) ID of the company, not a domain name
ENTRA_TENANT_ID.label: Tenant ID

ENTRA_CLIENT_ID.description: Application (client) ID of the app registration, which must send the upn claim
ENTRA_CLIENT_ID.label: Client ID

ENTRA_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of the app registration; renew it before it expires
ENTRA_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Client Secret

ENTRA_REDIRECT_URI.description: Public https address of /api/auth/callback, exactly as registered
ENTRA_REDIRECT_URI.label: Redirect URI

name: Workday
description: Annual leave days left, read from a custom report. Optional: without it the rest of the portal works.

WORKDAY_TOKEN_URL.description: https address that issues Workday access tokens
WORKDAY_TOKEN_URL.label: Token URL

WORKDAY_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of the app's API client in Workday
WORKDAY_CLIENT_ID.label: Client ID

WORKDAY_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Refresh token of the app's system account, limited to leave balances
WORKDAY_REFRESH_TOKEN.label: Refresh Token

WORKDAY_REPORT_URL.description: https address of the annual leave balance report (takes workEmail and asOfDate, returns daysLeft)
WORKDAY_REPORT_URL.label: Report URL

name: ZBrain Governance
description: Enterprise policy and Governance SDK authentication
